sources.title: Transport evidence bases in plan making and decision taking
sources.role: Planning Practice Guidance on strategic transport evidence
sources.facts: Describes scenario-based evidence, network capacity, cumulative impacts, accessibility, sustainable modes and infrastructure requirements.
sources.guard: Strategic evidence does not prove exact-site access, junction capacity, service frequency, viability or mitigation acceptance.

sources.title: Strategic road network and the delivery of sustainable development
sources.role: DfT and National Highways circular publication record
sources.facts: Circular 01/2022 explains National Highways engagement in plan-making and decision-taking for the strategic road network.
sources.origin: Department for Transport and National Highways / GOV.UK
sources.guard: Publication status does not prove National Highways agreement, connection approval, capacity or deliverability for a proposal.

sources.title: Strategic road network and the delivery of sustainable development - HTML
sources.facts: Applies to trunk motorways and all-purpose trunk roads in England and sets engagement principles for development impacts.
sources.origin: Department for Transport and National Highways / GOV.UK
sources.guard: Network policy does not establish a parcel's access rights, traffic impact, safety, capacity or consent outcome.

sources.title: Crossrail 2: safeguarding directions
sources.facts: Explains referral of applications in safeguarded areas to Transport for London and publishes directions and maps.
sources.guard: Safeguarding map presence does not prove exact boundary intersection, objection, acquisition, compensation or scheme delivery.

sources.title: HS2 safeguarding for developers and local authorities
sources.role: Current HS2 safeguarding directions and developer guidance
sources.facts: Last updated 25 March 2026; directions help identify sites requiring HS2 consultation and removed obsolete Annandale Depot material.
sources.guard: Safeguarding status does not prove final route, exact parcel effect, consultation response, blight eligibility or acquisition.

sources.title: East West Rail safeguarding directions
sources.role: Current rail safeguarding directions and guidance
sources.facts: Last updated 30 June 2026 to reflect revised proposals; relevant LPAs refer affected applications to East West Rail Company.
sources.guard: Direction and referral requirements do not prove route delivery, exact-site impact, consultation outcome or compensation.

sources.title: UK aviation forecast 2026
sources.role: Department for Transport strategic aviation forecast
sources.facts: Published 18 June 2026; provides long-term passenger, aircraft-movement and CO2 forecasts with supporting data tables.
sources.guard: Forecast values are strategic model outputs and do not prove airport capacity, local noise, planning consent or site demand.

sources.title: Safer Railway Scheme
sources.role: National rail safety and safeguarding accreditation framework
sources.facts: Published 22 May 2026; replaces earlier schemes and sets assessment criteria for participating rail organisations.
sources.guard: Scheme standards or accreditation do not prove route capacity, development safeguarding, operational performance or exact-site safety.
